Alpha Vantage API Documentation

Time Series Data

This category provides access to real-time and historical time series data for stocks, ETFs, and digital currencies. All data is delivered in JSON format and includes intraday, daily, weekly, and monthly intervals.

TIME_SERIES_INTRADAY

Get intraday time series data for a specific stock symbol. This endpoint returns real-time and historical intraday data with 1-minute intervals by default.

TIME_SERIES_DAILY

Get daily time series data for a specific stock symbol. This endpoint returns historical daily data including open, high, low, close prices and volume.

TIME_SERIES_WEEKLY

Get weekly time series data for a specific stock symbol. This endpoint returns historical weekly data aggregated from daily prices.

TIME_SERIES_MONTHLY

Get monthly time series data for a specific stock symbol. This endpoint returns historical monthly data aggregated from daily prices.

Fundamental Data

Access comprehensive fundamental data including company overview, income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements for publicly traded companies.

OVERVIEW

Get company overview information including market cap, P/E ratio, dividend yield, and other key financial metrics.
